The main companies are Taiyo Nippon Sanso Corporation (renamed Nippon Sanso Corporation effective April 1, 2026), NISSAN TANAKA Corporation, Nippon Ekitan Corporation, Nippon Megacare Corporation and I.M.I. In industrial gases, price management had an effect on carbon dioxide, packaged gases and electronic material gases, but revenue decreased as shipment volumes of separate gases and LP gas fell. In equipment and construction, revenue increased in electronics-related business due to progress in construction for medium- and large-scale projects, while revenue in industrial gas-related business decreased.
